papers.title_en: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
papers.authors: Yuwei Miao, Azim Dehghani Amirabad, Scott Oloff, Junzhou Huang, Tianyu Cui, Rui Liao
papers.evidence: 以潜在机制单元为核心的虚拟细胞世界模型预测遗传扰动响应
papers.tldr: 预测基因扰动下的细胞响应是虚拟细胞的核心能力，但现有模型多直接映射观测，缺少对潜在细胞状态转变的显式建模。VCLMU将细胞状态表示为潜在机制单元（LMU），把遗传扰动视为作用在这些状态上的动作，并先在大规模伪批量数据、后在单细胞扰动数据上两阶段预训练。在六个扰动不重叠基准上，它提升了扰动特异性响应恢复，同时保持有竞争力的整体响应精度。该工作表明机制级潜在状态转移可作为预测和解释细胞干预响应的有效范式。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.

papers.title_en: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
papers.authors: Bowen Han, Lingbei Meng, Shihuan Luo, Yupeng Zang, Wenlin LI, Peize He, Yaodi Luo, Lian Zhang, Jianqing Zhu, Jinchao Xu
papers.evidence: 源条件流匹配建模遗传与化学扰动下的单细胞群体转变
papers.tldr: 破坏性单细胞测量只能得到未配对群体快照，难以刻画跨条件群体转换。TempoBridge将源细胞作为固定经验群体摘要，以源条件流匹配和minibatch最优传输耦合学习转换速度场，推理无需目标表达或OT计算。在留出供体、基因组合和化合物上，其Energy distance、L2误差与药效相关性均优于scGen、scGPT-scratch和CellFlow适配器等基线。消融表明源上下文、OT耦合与流匹配均关键，为时间、遗传和化学扰动下的单细胞群体预测提供统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

papers.title_en: Beyond the Transcriptome: Chromatin-Informed Prediction of Cell-State-Dependent Perturbation Responses
papers.authors: Jiafa Ruan, Chenyang He, Ruijie Quan, Fanglei Xue, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang
papers.evidence: 染色质信息驱动的遗传扰动转录响应预测
papers.tldr: 预测基因扰动后的转录响应通常依赖转录组，忽略了染色质可及性所携带的细胞状态信息，且独立采样的对照与扰动群体存在基线差异。ChromaPert 将分子与DNA位点先验、配对对照RNA-ATAC特征结合，并用染色质引导响应路由CGRR检索对照来源偏移，再由条件传输流学习剩余响应。在K562 CAT-ATAC与Perturb-Multiome的未见靶点和留出状态评估中，其全基因响应相关性领先，跨状态迁移对已知扰动的相关性提升23.2%，高响应基因提升46.2%。该框架表明染色质信息可改善状态依赖的扰动响应预测。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is central to understanding gene function. Existing predictors primarily rely on transcriptomic measurements, although chromatin accessibility provides complementary information about the cellular context in which perturbations act. Using this information requires linking chromatin context to specific perturbations and accounting for baseline differences between independently sampled control and perturbed populations. We propose ChromaPert, a chromatin-informed framework for predicting state-dependent perturbation responses. ChromaPert combines molecular and DNA-informed locus priors with paired control RNA--ATAC features to jointly represent target identity and measured cellular context. Its Chromatin-Guided Response Router (CGRR) builds a source bank of control-derived expression offsets and retrieves relevant sources using perturbation/locus or control-ATAC similarity. These offsets account for baseline differences, while conditional transport flow learns the remaining response. Across three unseen-target and held-out-state settings on K562 CAT-ATAC and Perturb-Multiome, ChromaPert achieves the highest all-gene response correlation among evaluated methods. When transferring known perturbations to held-out states, it improves correlation by 23.2% across all genes and 46.2% for the twenty most responsive genes over the strongest respective baselines. Correct RNA--ATAC pairing improves recovery of chromatin-associated response slopes over shuffled pairing, while cross-state predictions retain state-specific responses to the same perturbation.

papers.title_en: Learning Perturbation-Specific Representations through Conditional Energy Prior for Cellular Response Prediction
papers.evidence: 用于细胞扰动响应预测的条件能量先验
papers.tldr: 细胞扰动预测中，扰动特异信号常被细胞复杂性掩盖，现有方法难以准确捕捉扰动效应。为此，作者提出PerturbEnergy，在扰动表示上引入条件能量先验，将潜空间显式偏向与给定扰动兼容的区域。该方法可嵌入自编码器，并提升表示与扰动间条件互信息下界。四个基准实验显示，潜空间扰动识别最高提升83.2%，top-50/100/200 DEG预测达SOTA。
papers.abstract_en: AI-based cellular perturbation prediction is essential to accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic identification. However, perturbation-specific signals are generally obscured by cellular complexity, making it difficult for existing methods to correctly capture perturbation effects. To address this problem, we propose PerturbEnergy, which introduces a conditional energy-based prior over perturbation representations. It assigns lower energy (higher probability) to representations compatible with the given perturbation and higher energy to others, thereby explicitly tilting the latent space toward perturbation-preferred regions. Besides, PerturbEnergy can be integrated into autoencoder architectures as we find its Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) is equivalent to the ELBO of the complete autoencoder. We further prove that optimizing PerturbEnergy increases the lower bound on the conditional mutual information between representation and perturbation. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our PerturbEnergy: it improves perturbation recognition especially in latent space with improvement of up to 83.2\%; It also achieves state-of-the-art performance for predicting top-50/100/200 differentially expressed gene(DEG) response and remaining competitive on highly variable gene(HVG) prediction. The code is provided: https://github.com/BlueWhaleLab/PerturbEnergy

papers.title_en: Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening
papers.evidence: 诊断扰动预测器对未见基因组合的外推能力
papers.tldr: 高通量扰动筛选常需预测未测量基因组合的效应，尤其两基因单独见过而组合未见时，常规OOD方法易失效。作者将模型预测与单基因效应相加的加性基线比较，提出加性分歧（AD）衡量额外交互效应。在8种方法和3个Perturb-seq数据集上，专用神经预测器并未稳定胜过加性基线，且AD越大误差往往越大。AD跨组合场景保持信息量，可辅助智能体筛选决策。
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.

papers.title_en: Deep learning-based virtual perturbation reveals increasing heterogeneity of gene regulatory responses with aging
papers.authors: Yongjian He, Julia Hanna Haddad Guez, Xu-Wen Wang, Orr Levy
papers.evidence: 从未扰动转录组预测虚拟基因扰动效应
papers.tldr: 衰老是否通过分子损伤累积导致转录调控失稳仍缺乏单细胞分辨率证据。研究采用深度学习框架DKO，从无扰动转录组预测细胞特异的虚拟基因敲除效应，并在人、小鼠、果蝇和线虫数据中验证。结果显示，随年龄增长，同一基因扰动的转录后果在细胞间日益异质，且与体细胞突变负荷和衰老评分升高相关。该工作将随机损伤与调控响应异质性联系起来，提示调控鲁棒性进行性丧失是衰老的保守特征。
papers.abstract_en: A central hypothesis in aging biology proposes that the gradual accumulation of stochastic molecular damage drives transcriptional deregulation (TD), ultimately leading to functional decline. However, existing single-cell analyses largely rely on static expression measurements and provide limited resolution of how regulatory responses change at the level of individual cells. Here, we leverage DKO, a deep learning framework that predicts cell-specific virtual gene perturbation effects from unperturbed transcriptomes, capturing cell-to-cell differences in regulatory context without requiring a reconstructed gene regulatory network or matched perturbation data. Applying DKO to single-cell transcriptomic datasets from humans, mice, Drosophila, and C. elegans revealed that the transcriptional consequences of perturbing the same gene became increasingly heterogeneous across cells with age, indicating that gene regulatory responses become less consistent and more dependent on cellular context. Furthermore, we find that cells with higher somatic mutation burdens have greater knockout-response variability, linking accumulated molecular damage to regulatory inconsistency. Within the same cellular populations, higher impact variability was also associated with higher senescence scores, linking transcriptional dysregulation to senescence-associated states. Our findings identify a progressive loss of regulatory robustness at both the gene and cell levels as a conserved feature of aging, linking stochastic molecular damage to increasing heterogeneity in cellular regulatory responses.

papers.title_en: Synergy-Aware Residual Flow Matching for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.evidence: 用于单细胞扰动响应预测的残差流匹配
papers.tldr: 组合扰动响应预测仍具挑战，因为响应很大程度可由单扰动加性效应解释，而具生物学意义的信号常位于较小的非加性残差中。SynGeneFlow将流匹配源分布锚定于加性先验，学习指向真实扰动状态的残差流，并融合静态基因图掩码与扰动相关形变偏置来动态建模基因互作。为保留群体响应结构，方法用MMD正则对齐终点分布与生物残差分布。在遗传和药物扰动基准的已见单扰动、留出与跨模态设置中，该框架表现出有效性和稳健性，为单细胞扰动预测提供了围绕加性效应残差化的新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting single-cell responses to genetic and chemical perturbations is important for understanding regulatory mechanisms and prioritizing therapeutic interventions. Existing methods have made progress by modeling perturbation-conditioned expression shifts with neural networks, graph priors, foundation-model representations, or distributional generative models. However, combinatorial perturbation prediction remains challenging because much of the response can be explained by additive single-perturbation effects, while the biologically informative signal often lies in a smaller non-additive residual induced by perturbation interactions. Directly generating the full post-perturbation expression profile may therefore allocate substantial capacity to the dominant additive component and underemphasize synergy-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SynGeneFlow}, a synergy-aware flow matching framework that anchors the source distribution at an additive prior and learns a residual flow toward the true perturbed state. SynGeneFlow further incorporates perturbation-conditioned gene interaction modeling, where a static gene-gene mask provides biological structure and a perturbation-dependent deformation bias dynamically modulates gene-gene coupling. To preserve population-level response structure, we align both endpoint distributions and biological residual distributions with MMD-based regularization. We evaluate SynGeneFlow on genetic and drug perturbation benchmarks under observed-single, held-out, and cross-modality settings. The results demonstrate that residualizing flow matching around additive perturbation effects provides a biologically grounded and robust framework for single-cell perturbation response prediction.

papers.title_en: CloneOT: predicting clone-specific perturbation responses with lineage-supervised neural inverse optimal transport
papers.authors: Yanshuo Chen, Wei Chen, Heng Huang
papers.evidence: 用谱系监督神经逆最优传输预测单细胞扰动响应
papers.tldr: 单细胞扰动响应预测需在扰动前后未配对细胞群体间建立映射，但现有神经最优传输依赖固定平方欧氏代价，易连错细胞。CloneOT利用部分谱系追踪条形码监督神经逆最优传输，同时学习传输代价与映射，使同克隆细胞在最低代价传输中保持相连。实验在2D数据恢复正确传输，并在14个癌症谱系追踪扰动场景中优于五个基线，且揭示耐药持留细胞的克隆特异转录程序并预测克隆命运。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting single-cell perturbation responses requires mapping between two unpaired populations of cells measured before and after the perturbation. Optimal transport (OT) provides a principled framework for constructing such mappings by minimizing the transport cost, and neural OT methods (\textit{e.g.}, CellOT) have been employed for this prediction task. However, these methods rely on a fixed transport cost, typically the squared Euclidean distance. This cost may connect cells with the wrong responses. Lineage tracing provides the information needed to learn the cost, as heritable barcodes link the cells of the same clone before and after the perturbation. Here, we propose \CloneOT, a neural inverse OT method that learns both the transport cost and the transport map from partially lineage-traced single-cell datasets. \CloneOT\ represents the cost as a neural network. It learns the cost by minimizing the extra cost that the lineage adds to the optimal transport, so that the cheapest transport keeps the cells of each clone together. Our experiments demonstrate that \CloneOT\ recovers the correct transport on 2D datasets, while the squared Euclidean cost fails. Moreover, \CloneOT\ outperforms five baselines on 14 lineage-tracing perturbation scenarios of cancer cells, for both seen and unseen clones. Furthermore, we show that \CloneOT\ reveals the clone-specific transcriptional programs of drug-tolerant persister cells and forecasts the fate of each clone from its cells before treatment. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/CloneOT.

papers.title_en: Panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes at scale with CellNet
papers.authors: Xiaoqing Lian, Pei Liu, Jiahui Tan, Luoda Tan, Chaoyi Li, Zhonghao Ren, Hongxin Xiang, Tianxu Lv, He Wang, Xiang Pan, Quan Zou, Chen Lin, Xiangxiang Zeng
papers.evidence: 大规模转录组数据预训练的单细胞基础模型
papers.tldr: 单细胞图谱亟需整体表征细胞状态，但现有基础模型难以充分利用全景转录组信息。CellNet将DNA来源的基因身份与实测RNA表达整合为共享图像表示，并在40个物种、逾百万基因的2.31亿个图像化细胞谱上预训练。该模型提升稀有及条件相关细胞状态识别，支持面板外基因研究，并关联非编码RNA与已知生物程序。它为全转录组尺度的AI细胞生物学发现提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensively characterizing cellular landscapes to elucidate cell diversity is a central goal in biology. Recent advances in single-cell profiling have created unprecedented opportunities for this endeavor by capturing diverse transcriptomes with remarkable breadth. However, current foundation models generally struggle to leverage such holistic and valuable information to represent a cell. Here we present CellNet, which enables panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes at scale by integrating DNA-derived gene identities and measured RNA expression into a shared image representation. Pretrained on 231 million image-based cell profiles across 40 species and covering over one million genes, CellNet improves the recognition of rare and condition-associated cellular states, enables the study of genes beyond experimentally measured panels, and uncovers associations between poorly characterized non-coding RNAs and known biological programmes. CellNet paves the way for AI-enabled cell-biology discovery at the whole-transcriptome scale. The CellNet website is available at https://www.cellnet.top.

papers.title_en: A Pitfall in the Evaluation of Gene Perturbation Models
papers.authors: George Panagopoulos, Saman Omidi, Tsz Pan Tong, Jun Pang
papers.evidence: 基因扰动模型预测未见干预时的评估陷阱
papers.tldr: 基因扰动模型评估常因指标与差异表达基因子集选择不一致而难以公平比较。作者在6个单基因扰动数据集上统一评测8种方法，发现改变Top DE基因数会使Precision排名剧烈波动，胜出方法变更率达86.7%。根源是许多方法将同一预测表达谱复制到细胞层面，放大显著性并产生过大显著DE集合，67.1%的扰动-基因对过阈值但效应可能极小。校正该陷阱后，基于GO特征的随机森林总体最佳。
papers.abstract_en: Gene perturbation models aim to predict transcriptional responses to unseen genetic interventions, but comparisons rely on heterogeneous evaluation metrics and differentially-expressed (DE) gene subsets. We investigate the consequences of these choices using eight methods across six single-gene perturbation datasets under a unified evaluation protocol. Varying the number of top DE genes reveals substantial instability in Precision-based rankings, with the winning method changing $86.7\%$ of the time, while rankings based on the rest of the metrics remain comparatively stable. Investigating this discrepancy exposes that repeating a single predicted expression profile across cell-level rows, a standard practice for many methods, can inflate significance estimates and produce excessively large predicted significant-DE sets. Specifically we found that $67.1\%$ of tested perturbation--gene pairs pass the significance threshold despite some of them having minuscule effects. We derive an inflation factor showing that replicated predictions can amplify the standardized Mann--Whitney statistic even after correction for tied ranks, without adding independent information. This artifact changes Precision mainly as the number of DE genes increases because for smaller cutoffs, most of the genes are already significant due to the effect-based ordering. Taking this pitfall into account in our benchmark comparison, we find that a random forest using Gene Ontology features achieves the best overall results.
